messages.subject: Invalidate all contexts (InvalidateLater)
parts:
Hi,

when I interpret invalidateLater correct then only the current context is invalidated. In my app I want to change the language, e.g. from English to German. That means all UI elements as well the graphics outputs needs to be redone. Is there a possibility to invalidate all contexts? Of course, I could put in all contexts "input$lang".

Thanks in advance

Sigbert
